guidelines.detail: refines FLOW-07 (The description specifies repeated name entry until a name is available, and the missing flow records the absent connection from an entry attempt to the availability decision. FLOW-07 requires representing stated loops but does not specify this decision-and-return structure.)

documentation rule FID-03 not applied (The label pairs show differences in meaning or scope, and the description supports the stated actions and decisions. The documented guideline FID-03 already requires short, faithful labels, so this proposal does not add a distinct rule.)

same as LRN-009 (The description explicitly requires account setup only when the account is absent, and the reference includes that conditional action while the generated model omits it. LRN-009 already covers modeling an optional activity as an exclusive-gateway branch and merging before a later required activity.)

same as LRN-020 (The description supports preserving the account, subscription-status, and character-selection details in labels, while the matched reference labels omit some of them. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-020.)

documentation rule GW-05 not applied (The description explicitly allows account setup and coming up with names to proceed in parallel, and the missing gateway record supports a needed synchronization. The documented parallel-join guideline already covers a shared continuation that waits for all active branches. This is also consistent with learned guideline LRN-010. Other recorded element differences do not change this evidence.)

refines FID-03 (The selected records support concise labels for single activities that include multiple values. This refines the documented guidance on short, faithful labels by specifying when details can be omitted; the other label pairs do not establish a similar omission issue.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says an activity is repeated until a stated condition is met: Model each attempt followed by a decision; loop back to repeat the activity when the condition is not met, and continue when it is met.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says an activity is repeated until a stated condition is met

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description explicitly states the meaning or level of detail of a decision or activity

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says an activity may or may not occur before a later required activity: model the optional activity as one branch of an exclusive gateway, and merge the branches before the later required activity
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an action is required only when a stated prerequisite is absent

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes an event or activity by its action, actor, object, recipient, or another meaningful qualifier: Label each BPMN element so that it preserves those stated details without substituting a broader or different meaning.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description specifies meaningful qualifiers or components that distinguish an activity or decision

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use a parallel join when a shared continuation waits for all active parallel branches. Never use it to join mutually exclusive alternatives.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that activities can proceed in parallel and that both must be complete before a later activity.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description groups multiple values or attributes within a single activity, such as details to enter or options to select: Label the BPMN activity with its core action and object rather than enumerating every value, unless distinguishing those values is necessary to identify separate modeled steps.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description groups multiple values or attributes within a single activity, such as details to enter or options to select
